mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_member (project_id, user_id, project_role, joined_at, added_by) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{userId}, #{projectRole}, now(), #{addedBy})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_member WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE project_member SET project_role = #{projectRole} WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id AS "userId", u.username AS "username", u.display_name AS "displayName", m.project_role AS "projectRole", m.joined_at AS "joinedAt" FROM project_member m JOIN app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY m.joined_at
SELECT count(*) FROM project_member WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
SELECT count(*) > 0 FROM project_member WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT project_role FROM project_member WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND user_id = #{userId}
